I’m sharing something I wish I’d known sooner ❤. If you’re experiencing the frequent headaches and migraine attacks of Chronic Migraine, you don’t have to just push through it. BOTOX® (onabotulinumtoxinA) is a Chronic Migraine treatment option that prevents headaches before they start. On average, BOTOX® prevents 8 to 9 headache days and migraine/probable migraine days a month (vs 6 to 7 for placebo). Why wait? Talk to your doctor and ask if BOTOX may be right for you.
